Enum Class CountryCode

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CountryCode>
se.michaelthelin.spotify.enums.CountryCode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CountryCode>, Constable
public enum CountryCode extends Enum<CountryCode>
An enumeration of the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, as used by Spotify's market and country parameters.

The constant name is the alpha-2 code itself, so toString() yields exactly what the Web API expects on the wire. The list is Locale.getISOCountries() plus XK, which is user-assigned rather than ISO-assigned but is the one market code Spotify returns that the JDK omits.
